prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Correct LH07-0107. Image 1 controls original selector anatomy. Image 2 is the landscape candidate to edit. Image 3 is the exact Japanese layout and typography authority. Image 4 is approved style guidance. Keep a tight landscape canvas matching the 390x302 framing of Image 3 (ratio 1.29:1), with no unused blank page area. Match these visible bounds at 390px width: question top y=25 on one line; country selector x=20,y=56,w=350,h=70; language selector x=20,y=138,w=350,h=71; 完了 action x=20,y=244,w=350,h=44. Compared with Image 3, Image 2 starts the question about20px too low, its rows are slightly too short, and its action gap is too small. Move the question and rows up to the specified positions, keep modest space between the two rows, and allow about35px between the second row and action. Preserve Image 3 exact Meiryo sizes, weights, line heights and wrapping; do not enlarge or thicken the text. Keep exactly these six strings and no others: どの国・地域と言語で利用しますか？; 国・地域; 米国; 言語; 英語; 完了. Keep the small US flag immediately before 米国, separate white outlined rows, right chevrons, neutral fine borders, slate chevrons, flat white and a forest-green action with white label. No toolbar, status/navigation bars, footer, outer card, extra controls, duplicated labels or decorative effects. Keep small white margins consistent with Image 3.

Question is5px low, rows are4-5px short/misaligned, action starts14px early and is4px short. Move controls to inspected reference bounds while preserving exact typography.
